desc: Select the wrap-delta method and derive the transition formula: for the value v that wraps, delta = 2*sumpos[v] - (N+1)*cnt[v].
Implement the complete solution: Fenwick-tree initial inversion count, cnt/sumpos arrays, and the M-line output loop with the descending wrap-value update.
Verify correctness on samples 1-3 (all passed) and edge cases by analysis (M=1, N=1, all equal values, duplicates).
